name: Zao Asian Cafe Seared Chicken Breast & Jasmine Rice Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper / Lehi / South Jordan)
whyItWorks: Seared lean chicken breast served over warm steamed white jasmine rice with light teriyaki glaze. Naturally dairy-free, low in fat, and devoid of tough vegetables or irritating seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Build a custom bowl: Base of jasmine white rice, protein of seared chicken breast, light teriyaki sauce. Skip raw carrots, wok vegetables, edamame, and spicy dragon sauce.
